changelog: **Skill autocomplete + dual-write onto the canonical taxonomy (#1818, epic #1810):** new `GET /api/skills/suggest?q=` — prefix/alias/contains search over the org's ACTIVE `Skill` vocabulary, labelled in the reader's language; signed in it reads the caller's own org (any role, never entitlement-gated), signed out it answers only for a public form context (`?mentorId=` of a link `/api/apply` accepts, or `?context=mentor-application` → the default org) and is rate-limited per IP. The shared `SkillsField` (all nine skill inputs since #2314) became an ARIA 1.2 combobox over it — arrows, Enter, Escape — committing the canonical label; a term not in the vocabulary is still accepted. Every write path of a skill list (`/api/profile`, `/api/users/[id]`, `/api/apply`, `/api/source/mentees`, mentor-application approval, `/api/requisitions` create/patch) now dual-writes: the JSON exactly as before plus `UserSkill` / `RequisitionSkill` rows mirrored by `syncUserSkills` / `syncRequisitionSkills` (`src/lib/skillsResolve.ts`), with unresolved terms parked as PENDING in the curation queue. An org without a vocabulary is seeded on first use (`ensureSkillTaxonomy`). CV-suggested skills arrive as canonical chips.

notes.en: Skill fields now suggest skills as you type — pick one with the arrow keys and Enter, so everyone's “React” is the same React. Anything not on the list can still be added.
notes.tr: Beceri alanları artık yazarken öneri sunuyor — ok tuşları ve Enter ile seç; böylece herkesin “React”i aynı React oluyor. Listede olmayan bir beceriyi yine de ekleyebilirsin.
notes.de: Skill-Felder schlagen jetzt beim Tippen Skills vor — mit Pfeiltasten und Enter auswählen, damit „React“ bei allen dasselbe React ist. Was nicht in der Liste steht, lässt sich trotzdem hinzufügen.
